items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: everyone used to come there and -- [INTERVIEWER] Which Harry? [INTERVIEWEE] Harry James.

ctx.x: So what happend is that the rhythm section was so fantastic until everybody used to come and jam at the Black Cat. Benny Goodman, Harry James, Basie, Lionel, because I had vibraphones. And everyone used to come there and --
And this was practically your first job in New York.
